scenes.label: Meet the team
scenes.title: The expected request
scenes.caption: Reva signs into the fictional repair portal on the classroom tablet. A matching approval prompt appears. Nikhil checks the device and time details with her before they continue through the school’s usual sign-in process.
scenes.speech: Reva signs into the fictional repair portal on the classroom tablet. A matching approval prompt appears. Nikhil checks the device and time details with her before they continue through the school’s usual sign-in process.
scenes.dialogue: Match the request to an action you started.

scenes.label: The problem
scenes.title: A request at rest
scenes.caption: Later, the tablet requests approval while neither learner is signing in. Its familiar logo cannot replace context. Reva refuses: repeated prompts are not a reason to approve an attempt she did not start.
scenes.speech: Later, the tablet requests approval while neither learner is signing in. Its familiar logo cannot replace context. Reva refuses: repeated prompts are not a reason to approve an attempt she did not start.
scenes.dialogue: Being interrupted does not create permission.

scenes.label: How it works
scenes.title: An unfamiliar session
scenes.caption: A supplied alert card lists a session they do not recognise. Nikhil wants to use its recovery link immediately. The teacher instead opens the portal through a saved school route, so the alert itself does not decide their destination.
scenes.speech: A supplied alert card lists a session they do not recognise. Nikhil wants to use its recovery link immediately. The teacher instead opens the portal through a saved school route, so the alert itself does not decide their destination.

scenes.label: Your decision
scenes.title: Do not approve to investigate
scenes.caption: The team chooses between approving the unexpected prompt, ignoring every alert forever and refusing it while asking for adult help. They record what appeared and when. Those observations support a response without claiming to identify the person behind the attempt.
scenes.speech: The team chooses between approving the unexpected prompt, ignoring every alert forever and refusing it while asking for adult help. They record what appeared and when. Those observations support a response without claiming to identify the person behind the attempt.

scenes.label: What changes
scenes.title: The adult-led check
scenes.caption: Through the verified account page, the teacher reviews the unfamiliar session and follows the school recovery process. Ending an unwanted session and checking account recovery settings address different concerns. Changing a password alone need not end every existing session.
scenes.speech: Through the verified account page, the teacher reviews the unfamiliar session and follows the school recovery process. Ending an unwanted session and checking account recovery settings address different concerns. Changing a password alone need not end every existing session.

scenes.label: Enter the lab
scenes.title: A lost practice device
scenes.caption: Now a fictional tablet is missing. Use supplied cards to plan session review, device reporting and recovery checks with the teacher. Do not enter real account information. Your response trace should explain what each action establishes and what remains uncertain.
scenes.speech: Now a fictional tablet is missing. Use supplied cards to plan session review, device reporting and recovery checks with the teacher. Do not enter real account information. Your response trace should explain what each action establishes and what remains uncertain.
scenes.dialogue: Protect the account through a known route.
